title: Custom IAM policies must allow CreateVolume from snapshots (#2190)

detection.reason: the controller's IAM policy is AWS-side; IRSA shows only the role ARN and EKS Pod Identity nothing at all

quote: If you are not using the AmazonEBSCSIDriverPolicy managed policy, a change to your EBS CSI Driver policy may be needed.
remediation: If the controller's role uses the AWS-managed AmazonEBSCSIDriverPolicy, nothing to do (AWS updated it in every partition on 2025-01-13). With a custom policy, apply the change in GitHub issue #2190: CreateVolume from a snapshot is now authorized against the snapshot resource as well, so the policy's ec2:CreateVolume statement must allow the snapshot ARN (and any tag conditions must not exclude it). Upstream: this applies to every driver version, upgraded or not.
verifyCommand: kubectl -n kube-system get sa ebs-csi-controller-sa -o jsonpath='{.metadata.annotations.eks\.amazonaws\.com/role-arn}{"\n"}'  # prints the controller's IRSA role (empty = EKS Pod Identity or node role); list its policies with aws iam list-attached-role-policies --role-name ROLE_NAME
